title: 我也卡过
end_card: 评论区说说  我们都在

cover.line: 把你不敢说的委屈 唱了一遍

pu.name: 蒲松龄
pu.desc_en: Pu Songling, a thin Qing dynasty scholar about 50, grey-streaked goatee, black round skullcap, long braided queue, faded navy blue long gown with a worn black vest

li.name: 李清照
li.desc_en: Li Qingzhao, Southern Song poet about 45, naturally beautiful mature face with fine lines at the eye corners and a few grey strands, calm single-lidded eyes, low bun with one silver hairpin, moon-white silk long jacket, barely-there makeup

xin.name: 辛弃疾
xin.desc_en: Xin Qiji, a burly Southern Song general about 50, square weathered face, sharp eyes, grey-streaked black beard, black futou cap, rust-brown round-collared robe with a wide leather belt, a long sword at his left hip

sha.name: 沙僧
sha.desc_en: Sha Wujing from Journey to the West, a huge gentle giant with dark bluish-grey skin, wild curly dark red hair and red beard, plain dark grey monk robe, a long necklace of big wooden beads with small carved skulls

tao.name: 陶渊明
tao.desc_en: Tao Yuanming, Eastern Jin poet about 45, lean and sunburnt, sleepy content eyes, scruffy short beard, grey kudzu headscarf with a small yellow chrysanthemum, loose undyed hemp robe, a hoe on his shoulder

liu.name: 柳永
liu.desc_en: Liu Yong, Northern Song lyricist about 35, handsome and rakish, charming half-smile, loose topknot tied with a white ribbon, pure white silk robe a little open at the collar

sima.name: 司马迁
sima.desc_en: Sima Qian, Western Han historian about 50, thin and gaunt, deep-set steady eyes, sparse short beard, tall black Han official cap, plain black deep robe with a dark red inner collar, a bundle of bamboo slips

jiang.name: 姜子牙
jiang.desc_en: Jiang Ziya, an ancient sage 72 years old, small and wiry, warm twinkling eyes, long white beard, white hair in a topknot, shaggy straw rain cape over a brown hemp robe, conical bamboo hat on his back, a bamboo fishing rod

group.back_row_en: a blue-grey giant with a red beard, a farmer in hemp with a hoe, a young man in white, a gaunt official in black, a white-bearded old man in a straw cape
group.rule_en: Li Qingzhao is the ONLY woman on the stage; nobody else wears white except the young man.

scene_en: live concert at night in light rain at the foot of a huge ancient Chinese city gate, red paper lanterns, haze, rain streaks catching the stage light, warm lantern light against cool blue rain, the foreground filled with blurred audience paper lanterns and phone lights

chorus8: 你说没事 我听得出来
是硬撑着 不想哭出来
不讲道理 不灌鸡汤
就坐你旁边 等天亮
这条路 我们都摔过
哪儿有坑 都给你标着
chorus4: 你说没事 我听得出来
是硬撑着 不想哭出来
pu: 我是蒲松龄 十九岁就考了第一
县府道三场 榜首全是我名字
所有人都说 这孩子了不起
然后我 再也没考上去
乡试三年一场 场场都落榜
从少年郎 考到白发苍苍
过年亲戚 问我考得怎么样
我说快了 明年一定上
在别人家 教了三十年书
学生一个个 走了我没走成的路
夜里点灯 写狐写鬼写糊涂
鬼比人好懂 狐比人靠谱
七十一岁 才补了个贡生
安慰奖也是奖 我笑着谢恩
你二战三战 不丢人
那几页没人要的鬼故事 后来养活了几代人
li: 我是李清照 年少就有才名
赌书泼茶 茶泼了一地也开心
十几屋的书画 是我们俩的命
一场兵荒 一路逃一路丢干净
过江的时候 只剩几箱破纸在手
他染了病 没熬过那个秋
我一个人 守着空屋子守
后来嫁错了人 一百天就看透
动手那天 我就去衙门告
宋朝的法 妻告夫要先坐牢
宁可去坐牢 也要把这婚离掉
满城的人 都在说我不好
你离过婚 被人背后指指点点说
没事 姐姐被说了快九百年了
物是人非 眼泪先流 也没关系的
哭完了 把要写的写完了
xin: 我是辛弃疾 二十二岁带五十骑闯营
五万人眼皮底下 把叛徒绑回了南方
那时我想 这辈子就该这样
一路往北打 打回我的故乡
后来 他们让我管钱管粮管治安
哪儿乱了 就派我去收烂摊
摊子收拾好 一纸调令就换
一封弹劾下来 让我回家歇着 别干
一歇 就是快二十年
把栏杆拍遍 没人问我一句冷暖
半夜喝多了 挑灯把剑看一眼
看完了 又把它挂回墙边
想说的话 到了嘴边就收
只说一句 天凉了 好个秋
你问中年人 怎么都不爱开口
不是没话说 是一张嘴 就收不了口
quick_a: 打碎一个杯子 丢了天上的编制
七天飞剑穿一回胸 像不像你的周例会
五斗米我不折腰 裸辞回了老家
种的豆子 草比苗还高 我也没混成啥
皇上说且去填词 我就真去填了
后来有井水的地方 都在唱我的歌
quick_b: 替朋友说了一句公道话 受了最狠的刑
我没去死 那本书还差一半没写完
我在河边 钓了很多年不咬钩的鱼
七十二岁 才等到那个人 你急什么
日子不是 每天都得赢
有的天 活下来 就算赢

PU01.camera: pushes in from medium to waist-up

actions.2.1: he pats his own shoulder like the adults did

actions.2.1: his finger writes characters in the air

actions.1.1: he cups his hands in a polite bow
actions.2.1: he points gently toward the audience

CH1.framing: medium shot of the front row

actions.3.1: the three smile at each other, Li Qingzhao moves one step closer to her microphone

LI01.framing: medium shot pushing to a waist-up shot
LI01.camera: pushes in from medium to waist-up

actions.1.0: she mimes playfully splashing tea and laughs
actions.2.1: she presses a hand to her chest

actions.0.1: her hands show a small thin stack
her hand slaps the mic stand once
actions.1.1: she lifts both wrists together as if in shackles
actions.2.1: a sharp decisive shake of the head
actions.3.1: chin up, a faint cold smile, one tear

actions.1.0: she smiles warmly at the audience
actions.3.1: her hand mimes writing with a brush

CH2.framing: medium shot of the front row, phone lights everywhere

actions.3.1: Li Qingzhao steps back and Xin Qiji strides forward and grips the center microphone stand

actions.1.1: he clenches a fist and yanks it back
actions.3.1: he points far to the north
a forced bitter grin, shoulders sinking

actions.2.1: he half draws the sword at his hip
actions.3.1: he slowly slides the sword back into its sheath

XIN04.mood: holding it in, then bursting out

actions.1.1: he looks up into the rain and shakes his head with a smile
actions.3.1: red-eyed, he shouts the line out

actions.0.0: he holds an invisible cup in both hands and lets it drop

actions.1.1: he looks at a handful of weeds and scratches his head
he turns and points to the crowd, who sing along
he raises the bundle of bamboo slips

actions.1.1: he smiles and points gently at the camera
